foreman.title: Foreman
foreman.sub: The Office: the mandates you give the Foreman, the gate runs deciding gates, and the directives it records. Chats: talk with the Foreman.

chats.emptyBody: Ask the Foreman about the board, or have it act for you through the CLI.
chats.pick: Pick a chat, or start a new one.
chats.archiveConfirm: Archive this chat? It stops its session, and an archived chat can't be reopened.
chats.logEmpty: Send a message to start. The Foreman reads the board before it replies.
chats.trimmed: Showing the newest {max} entries. {cmd} prints the full history.
chats.placeholder: Ask the Foreman about the board…
chats.daemonDisabled: Chats run in the daemon. Set {daemonKey} in {file} to use them.
chats.daemonStopped: Chats run in the daemon. Start it to send a message.
chats.archivedNote: This chat is archived. Start a new chat to keep talking.

office.offMandates: Mandates stay listable and editable while it is off.
office.noMandatesHow: New mandate creates one, as does {cmd} in a terminal.

gatesWaiting.one: {count} gate waiting for a gate run
gatesWaiting.other: {count} gates waiting for a gate run

mandate.intake: set when its milestone draft is filed
mandate.closeFinal: Closing is final: the mandate starts no more work, and the next link of its chain starts.

editor.title: Title
editor.listsHint: Comma-separated. Issues need order listed and no milestones or labels.
editor.noGrantable: The config grants no class a mandate may be given (foreman.decides).
editor.ungranted: Checked and disabled: written on the mandate, but the config does not grant it.
editor.guidanceHint: {count}/{max} characters. Fenced as data wherever it reaches a brief.

hints.title: One line naming the mandate, shown on its card and in its directives. At most 200 characters.
hints.scope: Which tracker issues this mandate works on. Give milestones, labels or a list of issues.
hints.milestones: Milestones whose open issues are in scope, worked one milestone at a time, in the order given.
hints.labels: Open issues carrying every one of these labels are in scope (within each milestone, when milestones are set).
hints.issues: Exact issues to work, in the order given. Needs Order set to listed, and no milestones or labels.
hints.until: Where each job's work stops: merge-ready (an open PR waiting for review) or merged. Merged applies only when foreman.ship is merge.
hints.maxJobs: How many of its jobs may run at once, 1 to 16.
hints.order: How the next issue is picked: graph follows dependencies, priority the tracker's priority, listed the Issues list in order.
hints.budgetUsd: Its spend cap in USD. Once its jobs have spent this much, the Office pass pauses the mandate.
hints.budgetJobs: How many jobs it may start. Once it has started this many with issues left, the Office pass pauses it. Split jobs don't count.
hints.stallCadences: How many Office passes (every foreman.cadence minutes) may go by with no progress before the mandate is paused as stalled.
hints.stallBounces: How many times one job may come back to the same gate before that gate is left for you (the bounce hold).
hints.onUnfinishable: What happens to a job that failed: park leaves it failed for you to retry, cancel cancels it.
hints.after: Start this mandate only once the chosen mandate is closed, so mandates run one after another as a chain.
hints.decides: The gates the Foreman may decide on its own for this mandate's jobs. Only classes the project's foreman.decides grants are offered; unchecked gates wait for you.
hints.guidance: Free-text instructions for the Foreman. It reads them as data, fenced, and they never widen what it may decide.

classes.specApproval: Approve a job's spec, or send it back for revision, so building starts without you.
classes.splitApproval: Approve or revise the planner's split of a large request into several jobs.
classes.escalation: Decide a job the approver escalated: approve it, revise its spec or send it back for rework.
classes.roundsExhausted: Decide a job that used up its review rounds: approve it, revise its spec or order another rework. Past the total-round ceiling it stays yours.
classes.conflicts: Approve fixing a PR that conflicts with its base branch, which sends the job to the integrator.
classes.prFeedback: Send a job back to rework when its open PR gets requested changes or failing checks, without waiting for you.
classes.repoProposal: Approve or reject an agent's request to add another repo to a job, which widens the repos the job pushes to.
classes.release: Approve a job's release plan, which publishes versions that can't be unpublished. Also needs gate:release removed from foreman.reserved.
classes.milestoneApproval: Approve or revise this goal mandate's milestone draft, which files its issues to the tracker. Rejecting it stays yours.
